name: report-to-declaration
description: Demonstration: a published sustainability report in, a candidate sustainability-data declaration out, with a verbatim quote behind every figure, conflicting values refused, and a named reviewer required before anything says it was checked.

scripts.demo: node extract.mjs --source fixtures/demo-report.txt --replay fixtures/demo-model-reply.json --target 'Example Hosting Ltd' --methodology-uri https://hosting.example/reports/2025.pdf --target-type organization --source-differs --out ./out
